sources.excerpt: Preserved strict 29-contract generation and reviewed baseline revision 5 with twelve unchanged task labels, 29 owners and prior content-addressed archive. Receipt result extension is bounded by publication. Source hash and generated drift check pass; later client/evaluation qualification remains pending.

Preserved typed read/publication/CAS/currency contracts; 20 publication fault/process tests pass. Shared journal now covers outbox acknowledgment and explicit gated epoch archive. Graph currency never advances on metadata/replay. Retirement is an unactivated maintenance port until job/client adoption; Windows fixture behavior is qualified, not Linux/macOS or power loss.

Shared 31-URI resolver has whole-record pages, signed instance/revision/process cursors, explicit unknown/unavailable/oversized signals, canonical family/history adapters, identical MCP/query meanings and valid JSON output. Resource/read-model fixtures and complete root regression pass. Retrieval/plugin/client consumption remains the subsequent owning slices.

Actual enrichment uses fresh typed three-way deltas with index/checkpoint publication, source-byte checks, preserved human edits/deletion, durable small batch outcomes and lost-reply recovery. Source MCP writes record intent/gap/dirty scope, recover without repeated effects, and reconciliation acknowledges graph deltas atomically. 18 batch, 65 parser, 10 source/C17-double and publication/reconciliation fixtures pass; actual targeted jobs/GUI/remaining producers are later integrations.

Independent six-role policies preserve arbitrary selected models and precedence, separate API/native CLI/privacy/pricing, expose requested/effective diagnostics and fingerprint, persist CAS/replay/restore and immutable snapshots. Temperature omission is model/reasoning-qualified and preserves cognitive instructions/model/effort, with no capability probe or escalation. Role/provider fixtures pass. Complete adapter/job/dashboard/candidate adoption remains 8/6/10/9.
